about: The Secret of the First Sunday of Advent, said over the offerings in a voice nobody hears. It asks that these holy things cleanse us by their power and bring us purer to Him who is their beginning. The missal prints its conclusion in the two words Per Dóminum, and this edition keeps the abbreviation.

s01.translation: May these sacred offerings, O Lord, cleanse us by mighty power and make us purer to approach their source. Through the Lord.

w002.function: With “Hæc” (w001), it forms the subject of “fáciant” (w010): these sacred offerings.

w003.function: The accusative subject of the infinitive “veníre” (w012) in a construction depending on “fáciant” (w010).

w007.function: An accusative plural participle agreeing with “nos” (w003).

w011.function: A comparative accusative plural referring to “nos” (w003).
